floater.name: wolf_experience_submit
floater.title: Add your experience

button.label: Add
button.name: sec_add
button.tool_tip: Fill in a card for a place you made.

button.label: My experiences
button.name: sec_mine
button.tool_tip: The experiences you sent: waiting, live or not approved.

button.label: Waiting for review
button.name: sec_review
button.tool_tip: Grid admins: experiences residents sent, to visit and approve or reject.

floater.text: Stand where people should arrive and fill in the card. A grid admin checks it before new residents see it in Wolf Experiences.

line_editor.name: add_region
line_editor.tool_tip: The region where people arrive, exactly as the grid names it.

spinner.label: X
spinner.name: add_x
spinner.tool_tip: East-west position in the region, metres.

spinner.label: Y
spinner.name: add_y
spinner.tool_tip: North-south position in the region, metres.

button.label: Use where I stand
button.name: add_here
button.tool_tip: Fill in the region, position and parcel picture from where you stand now.

line_editor.name: add_title
line_editor.tool_tip: The card's title: an activity, up to 40 characters.

floater.text: An activity, e.g. "Ride the coast train" (up to 40 characters).

line_editor.name: add_blurb
line_editor.tool_tip: One sentence about it, up to 140 characters.

floater.text: One sentence about it (up to 140 characters).

line_editor.name: add_arrive
line_editor.tool_tip: Shown to people when they land: the first thing to do, up to 140 characters.

floater.text: The first thing to do, e.g. "Take a seat at gate 1" (up to 140).

combo_box.name: add_category
combo_box.tool_tip: Where it is listed in Wolf Experiences.

texture_picker.name: add_picture
texture_picker.tool_tip: The card's picture. Click to choose another.

floater.text: Starts as this parcel's snapshot. Click the picture to choose another; None shows the category's icon. Or upload your own:

button.label: Upload a picture…
button.name: add_upload
button.tool_tip: Upload an image from your computer (PNG, JPEG, TGA or BMP) as the card's picture. It is saved in your Textures folder; the grid's usual upload fee applies.

button.label: Cancel
button.name: add_cancel
button.tool_tip: Close without sending. What you typed is kept for next time.

button.label: Submit for review
button.name: add_submit
button.tool_tip: Send the card to the grid admins. You can follow it under My experiences.

button.label: Refresh
button.name: mine_refresh
button.tool_tip: Ask the grid for your experiences' status again.

button.label: Withdraw
button.name: mine_withdraw
button.tool_tip: Take the chosen experience out of review, or out of Wolf Experiences if it is live.

line_editor.name: review_note
line_editor.tool_tip: Optional. The builder sees it under My experiences - say why when you reject.

button.label: Refresh
button.name: review_refresh
button.tool_tip: Ask the grid for the waiting list again.

button.label: Go
button.name: review_go
button.tool_tip: Teleport to the chosen experience to see it before deciding.

button.label: Reject
button.name: review_reject
button.tool_tip: Do not show it. Your note goes to the builder.

button.label: Approve
button.name: review_approve
button.tool_tip: Show it in Wolf Experiences now.
